# interfere_surface (Data Source)

Look up an existing surface without managing its lifecycle.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "interfere_surface" "web" {
  workspace_slug = "example"
  slug           = "web"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Schema

### Required

- `slug` (String)
- `workspace_slug` (String)

### Read-Only

- `anonymous_user_tracking` (Boolean)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `name` (String)
- `type` (String)
